channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mitchell Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mitchell Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Andre Drummond, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Jalen Brunson on Mitchell Robinson:

“Obviously, Mitch was near and dear to all our hearts. I think the best part about the situation Andre Drummond is in, he’s not coming in to be Mitch, he’s coming in to be himself. We got to give him the confidence to go out there and be himself. This is a new team, this is a new journey, so everything for us is going to be new and we’re going to attack it every day. We put everyone in the position to be successful and just give each other confidence and encouragement.”

Jalen Brunson on Andre Drummond, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Luka Garza on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Luka Garza on Mitchell Robinson joining the Celtics:

“I love his game. He’s one of those guys that you hate going against…It’s good to have him on this side.”

Luka Garza on Mitchell Robinson, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Sweetney on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Sweetney noticed how the Knicks and the media supported Mitchell Robinson during the playoffs.

“I’m glad it is where it is today, where people are coming out and feel comfortable talking about it. Like (Mitchell Robinson) just came out and said what he said. I don’t think during my playing time anybody would have done that,”

Michael Sweetney on Mitchell Robinson, Sep 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Payton Pritchard on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Payton Pritchard on the addition of Mitchell Robinson:

“I was his roommate when I was in college one time for USA. I think he is going to be great for us. The things we need, the rebounding, the toughness inside, he is going to bring it. Just adding to that big depth that we already have with Neemias and Luka, and then obviously Mitchell now, it is just going to be really good in that area.”

Payton Pritchard on Mitchell Robinson, Aug 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Andre Drummond on joining Knicks:

“I think this what they need rn. Getting rid of Mitchell Robinson hugeloss…I bring in a similar talent & energy…but I'm a vet, been around long time, know what it takes to win. Excited to be in a new role…going back to a place I'm familiar withMika Ortiz”

Andre Drummond on Mitchell Robinson, Jul 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Mitchell Robinson, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Robinson:

“Been here for 8 years, now here we are in the Finals. I can truly say I done seen it all.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Mitchell Robinson, Victor Wembanyama, Jun 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
James L. Edwards III: Brown on the Robinson incident:

“It’s tough because when you’re up big, stuff happens. It’s hard if someone feels like something that shouldn’t happen, happens, it’s hard to keep your composure in the moment.”

Mike Brown on Mitchell Robinson, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Free throws, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“So [Robinson] won’t be out there a ton, but if we need a rebound, he’s going to be out there.“And he’s got to knock down the free throws. And he’s working at it, we’re working at it with him, and I truly believe he’s going to get better.”

Mike Brown on Free throws, Mitchell Robinson, Nov 21, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Haliburton said before catching himself.

“Everybody is on me to rebound,so just trying to step up there and be the best I could. Everybody’s boxing their guy out, but especially Mitchell Robinson, Josh Hart, they got so many guys that just crash the glass like crazy and I’m just trying to come in and clean it up. And I thought I did a decent job at that.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson, May 29, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: OG Anunoby on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
OG Anunoby:

“What Mitchell Robinson does is special. I don't think there's anyone in the league who can do what he does. ... He's a 1-of-1.”

OG Anunoby on Mitchell Robinson, May 26, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Holiday on how they didn't blow a 20pt lead this time:

“We sustained their punches. We tried to keep the energy low in here...not making too many stupid mistakes, and then rebounding the ball...making it difficult on J.Hart getting offensive rebounds, Hart, as well as Robinson.”

Jrue Holiday on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson, May 12, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Joe Mazzulla on Mitchell Robinson fouling:

“Just process over results. Always stick to the process of what gives you the best chance to win.”

Joe Mazzulla on Mitchell Robinson, May 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“I think Julius is more of a power forward, but a terrific player. When you look at what he did for us, the scoring, the passing, rebounding, but it’s at the power forward position. “We had a great need obviously with Mitchell Robinson [injured] and Isaiah [Hartenstein] losing [him] in free agency. We needed a center. That was a big part of it, so I think the center position … when I look at Karl, I like his versatility and his size is important to us.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 14, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Mitchell Robinson playing hurt through the playoff run:

“He gave us everything he had. That's all you can ask of a player. What he gave us was tremendous.”

Tom Thibodeau on Mitchell Robinson, May 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Josh Hart on Joel Embiid, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Josh Hart on the Embiid flagrant on Mitchell Robinson:

“I’m all for tough fouls or playoff fouls but that’s something that can put a guy out for a significant amount of time.”

Josh Hart on Joel Embiid, Mitchell Robinson, Apr 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“I knew he was gonna take that matchup with Mitchell Robinson being number one in the NBA in offensive rebounding,”

Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Mitchell Robinson, Nov 21, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Josh Hart on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Josh Hart on Mitchell Robinson:

“He showed this series why he’s one of the best bigs in the league. He was huge for us on the defensive end. He’s got to be the best rebounder in the leaguein terms of how he goes and gets the ball.”

Josh Hart on Mitchell Robinson, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: James Dolan on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“They’re not at the top of the league, but they’re not at the bottom and they’re in a playoff position now. We just lost a player — Mitchell Robinson — for four weeks and he was important to us. So we have to make it through the next four weeks.”

James Dolan on Mitchell Robinson, Jan 26, 2023. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Derrick Rose on Mitchell Robinson:

“I'm happy that he's on my team. And he's a talent. I've played with guys that won defensive player of the year. I feel like Mitch has that ability, once he gets healthy, to win it.”

Derrick Rose on Mitchell Robinson, Oct 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Ian Begley:Tom Thibodeau was asked about NYK's young players:

“Based on film, I really think RJ (Barrett) has a very bright future as does Mitchell Robinson. Those are 2 who stand out. But we have a lot of young talent. I don’t like to make qualifications on people until I get around them.”

Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Mitchell Robinson, Jul 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Fizdale said after Tuesday's practice.

“I'm leaning toward him [starting] because [rookie center Mitchell [Robinson is] still running into the same thing with the fouls. And so to try to max out Mitchell's minutes, I have to bring him off the bench right now.”

David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Jan 22, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“For a guy that didn’t play a whole year of basketball, man, he absorbs stuff fast and he applies it to the game pretty quickly. I’m looking at our team and I’m looking at our future, and we understand that to build the organization and the team that we want, we got to be a defensive-minded team, and Mitchell Robinson is a superior natural defender, so I just felt like let’s get this generated now.“He’s going to be our foundation, our anchor of our defense for the future. Let’s get this guy going right now and really commit to the development of these guysand to what it’s going to take to get them to where they need to be for us to be the team we’re going to be later.”

David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Nov 4, 2018. Source: New York Post.

item.title: David Fizdale on Patrick Ewing, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“I mean, come on. If Mitchell Robinson gets to spend any time with Patrick Ewing that's a plus for us.”

David Fizdale on Patrick Ewing, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 1, 2018. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: David Fizdale on Enes Kanter Freedom, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson:

“He’s dealing w/ Enes Kanter every day, who’s a top-5 post-up player in our league. An absolute bruiser... You can see we still got to get him better with his post defense... but overall, the kid can block shots, he can run, and he can catch lobs.”

David Fizdale on Enes Kanter Freedom, Mitchell Robinson, Sep 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox
item.description:
Fizdale told Channel 4 New York's Bruce Beck.

“Kristaps (Porzingis) will come back healthy. He was already having a big time season last year when he got knocked down. We had an awesome draft with Kevin Knox, Mitchell Robinson, and Allonzo Trier - our two-way player.”

David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox, Aug 23, 2018. Source: The Score.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox
item.description:
“We talked about the kids we drafted (Kevin Knox and Mitchell Robinson). I've tried to make sure that he's -- we've been in communication on every decision that we've made.”

David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox, Jul 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.
